cohort: Term singleton infants born in the USA between January 2021 and December 2022 were included, totaling 4,978,703 individuals.
finding: The risk of neonatal respiratory failure (NRF) was significantly higher for term infants born at 37, 38, 40, and 41 weeks of gestational age compared to those born at 39 weeks.
mod_finding: Similar trends of increased NRF risk at non-39-week gestational ages were consistently observed across both vaginal and cesarean delivery modes, including elective cesarean sections.
followup_time: within the first days of life
